python3 - <<'PY'
import json,pathlib

node --input-type=module - <<'JS'
import{readFile,writeFile}from'node:fs/promises';import{createHash}from'node:crypto';const p='/Users/itayzrihan/Movies/OpenCut Accounts/data/4fec0688-9a78-4304-849c-9ea937873751/projects/11e7e552-fd67-44e7-8795-cd2b8b5e2668/project.json';const data=JSON.parse(await readFile(p,'utf8'));const info={scenesHash:createHash('sha256').update(JSON.stringify(data.scenes)).digest('hex'),transcriptHash:createHash('sha256').update(JSON.stringify(data.transcriptionJobs)).digest('hex'),path:p,sceneCount:data.scenes.length};await writeFile('.local/sequence-navigation/project-before.json',JSON.stringify(info));console.log('Preservation hashes captured',info.sceneCount);
